description_en: Queries the information about a product instance
name: GetProvisionedProduct

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product instance
parameters.name: provisioned_product_id

ProvisionedProductDetail.description_en: The details of the product instance

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the product instance was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例创建时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

LastProvisioningTaskId.description_en:
The ID of the task that was last run on the product instance.

The task can be one of the following types:

LaunchProduct: a task that launches the product.

UpdateProvisionedProduct: a task that updates the information about the product instance.

TerminateProvisionedProduct: a task that terminates the product instance
LastProvisioningTaskId.description_zh:
上一次执行的实例操作任务ID。

实例操作包括：

LaunchProduct：启动产品。
UpdateProvisionedProduct：更新实例。
TerminateProvisionedProduct：终止实例
LastProvisioningTaskId.title_en: 上一次执行的实例操作任务ID
LastProvisioningTaskId.title_zh: 上一次执行的实例操作任务ID

LastSuccessfulProvisioningTaskId.description_en:
The ID of the last task that was successfully run on the product instance.

The task can be one of the following types:

LaunchProduct: a task that launches the product.

UpdateProvisionedProduct: a task that updates the information about the product instance.

TerminateProvisionedProduct: a task that terminates the product instance
LastSuccessfulProvisioningTaskId.description_zh:
上一次成功执行的实例操作任务ID。

实例操作包括：

LaunchProduct：启动产品。
UpdateProvisionedProduct：更新实例。
TerminateProvisionedProduct：终止实例
LastSuccessfulProvisioningTaskId.title_en: 上一次成功执行的实例操作任务ID
LastSuccessfulProvisioningTaskId.title_zh: 上一次成功执行的实例操作任务ID

LastTaskId.description_en: The ID of the task that was last run

OwnerPrincipalId.description_en: The ID of the RAM entity to which the product instance belongs

OwnerPrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the Resource Access Management (RAM) entity to which the product instance belongs. Valid values:

RamUser: a RAM user

RamRole: a RAM role
OwnerPrincipalType.description_zh:
实例归属人的RAM实体类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。
RamRole：RAM角色

PortfolioId.description_en: The ID of the product portfolio

ProductVersionId.description_en: The ID of the product version

ProductVersionName.description_en: The name of the product version

ProvisionedProductArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the product instance

ProvisionedProductId.description_en: The ID of the product instance

ProvisionedProductName.description_en: The name of the product instance

ProvisionedProductType.description_en:
The type of the product instance.

The value is fixed as RosStack, which indicates an ROS stack
ProvisionedProductType.description_zh:
实例类型。

取值为RosStack，表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）的资源栈

StackId.description_en: The ID of the Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) stack
StackId.description_zh: 阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）资源栈ID

StackRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region to which the ROS stack belongs
StackRegionId.description_zh: 阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）资源栈所属的地域ID

Status.description_en:
The state of the product instance. Valid values:

Available: The product instance was available.

UnderChange: The information about the product instance was being changed.

Error: An exception occurred on the product instance
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值：

Available：可用。
UnderChange：变更中。
Error：异常

StatusMessage.description_en:
The message that is returned for the status of the product instance.

This parameter is returned only when Error is returned for the Status parameter
StatusMessage.description_zh:
实例状态信息。

仅在实例状态为Error时，返回该参数
StatusMessage.example: Resource CREATE failed: terraform stack sc-146611588617****-pp-bp1ddg1n2a**** failure...
